module: "Vehicle event debug" ImGui window to inspect vehicle triggers: shows the state of core_vehicleTriggers (camera, held trigger, hovered position, labels), lists vehicles with their triggers, action links and JBeam events, and lets you fire them with the mouse. Loaded by core_vehicleTriggers.enableDebugUI() and unloaded by disableDebugUI(). A vehicle modder uses it to check their triggers and triggerEventLinks sections.
usage:
core_vehicleTriggers.enableDebugUI()  -- opens the window
core_vehicleTriggers.disableDebugUI() -- closes it
notes: Not to be used directly: it depends on core_vehicleTriggers and core_vehicle_vehicleTriggerHighlight and reads core_vehicleTriggers.state.

The "trigger" buttons execute the Lua onDown/onUp strings of the events in the vehicle (queueLuaCommand); links go through a local copy of executeLink that forces player 0 (a difference from the local executeLink function of vehicleTriggers.lua, which passes the player).
The local copy of executeLink does not fire the onVehicleTriggersExecuteLink hook.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called after an extensions reload: restores the highlighted triggers through core_vehicle_vehicleTriggerHighlight.setSerializedHighlightedTriggerData.

onSerialize.desc: Hook called before an extensions reload: saves the highlighted triggers.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: draws the debug ImGui window.
